stem: Why should you periodically review your service charges?
options: To see if they compare with market competition
Because regulators require a new fee every year
To make sure every account pays the same fee
So you can raise them at every review

flashcard.front: Why should you periodically review your service charges?
flashcard.back: To see if they compare with market competition

stem: Which of these should you consider when monitoring your CD program?
options: Current market rates for your locations

flashcard.front: What are some things to consider when monitoring your CD program?
flashcard.back: Exception rates, early withdrawal penalty waivers, current market rates for your locations

stem: Why do you review your deposit program?
options: To see how it compares with market competition, whether it's priced within or outside of market scope, and its fees
To decide which branches to close
To count how many accounts each employee opened

flashcard.front: Why do you review your deposit program?
flashcard.back: To see if they compare with market competition, priced within or outside of market scope, fees
